Read the beta boundaries and technical notes +

What the data establishes

The original source is an archived response from the project’s public API. Its three records were matched against public Sepolia event logs and historical Core views. The checks cover rounds, work, completed blocks, cumulative endpoints, transaction identities and timing.

Those checks corroborate values recorded on Ethereum. They do not establish physical sensor truth, contract security or official endorsement. “Work” means accepted magnet passages; it does not identify the animal’s physical path, direction or behavior.

What comes next

The Sepolia rehearsal pins the independently observed Core and verifies the archived values at deployment. The current developer reference identifies an older deployment generation, so official support remains unconfirmed. Genesis attribution and project approval remain separate team decisions.

Original artwork and renderer by the Wheelprints project. No Squeek NFT artwork is copied. The studio exports images; the separate testnet page reports whether a test contract is configured. No mainnet collection has been released.

Before you keep a print

A few useful answers.

An art studio built around a recorded moment.

Is it free? Do I need a wallet?

The studio is free to explore and export without a wallet. The separate Sepolia test mint uses a connected wallet and test ETH for network gas; its mint price is zero.

Am I minting an NFT?

Downloading a print from this studio does not create a token. The separate Sepolia page can create test tokens after its contract deployment is configured and checked. Test tokens do not promise a mainnet allocation or reward.

Is the activity live?

This release uses three ten-minute records from October 30, 2026, captured from Squeekchain’s public Sepolia API. Each print keeps that snapshot so the same settings can reproduce it.

How do I keep or share a print?

Choose your record, form, and palette, then download an SVG or PNG. The SVG includes source metadata; the source-record panel also provides a JSON file to keep alongside your image. Copy print link keeps the same composition in the studio.
